Nearest City: St. Louis, MO
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION FLUID
Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party: VALVOLINE
Skytruth Analysis
CALLER STATED THAT DUE TO AN INVENTORY DISCREPANCY AT A BULK LUBE OIL FACILITY, AN UNDERGROUND TRANSFER LINE WAS PRESSURE TESTED. THE INVENTORY DISCREPANCY WAS 10000 GALLONS OF AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION FLUID. THIS DISCREPANCY COULD POTENTIALLY BE AN ACTUAL LOSS OF MATERIAL OR NOT, PERSONNEL DO NOT KNOW AT THIS TIME. THE LINE TESTED TRANSFERS AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION FLUID FROM A LARGE OUTDOOR ABOVE GROUND TANK TO SMALLER INDOOR TANKS. THE LINE ITSELF IS BELOW GROUND. IT FAILED THE PRESSURE TEST AND IS NOW SECURED. NO TRANSMISSION FLUID WAS SEEN DURING A SEARCH OF STORM DRAINS AND SECONDARY CONTAINMENT DONE BY FACILITY PERSONNEL AND A MISSOURI DNR OFFICIAL.

Report Description/// THIS IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1476470 /// THE UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: THE CALLER STATED THAT A HYDRAULIC HOSE ON A CARGO CRANE LOCATED ON A VESSEL RELEASED HYDRAULIC FLUID. THE AMOUNT OF MATERIAL THAT WAS RELEASED IS UNKNOWN, HOWEVER THEY STATED NO LESS THAN (10) GALLONS RELEASED. THE MATERIAL RELEASED ONTO THE DECK OF THE VESSEL AND ONTO THE TERMINAL DOCK. CRANE OPERATIONS WERE CEASED AND THE RELEASE OCCURRED FOR (3-4) MINUTES, UNTIL THE CONTAINER WAS LANDED IN THE HOLD. THE RELEASE COVERED (500) SQUARE METERS OF THE BERTH APRON. THE RELEASE AFFECTED TERMINAL EQUIPMENT AND CONTAINERS AT THE LOCATION. A CONTRACTOR WAS NOTIFIED TO CONDUCT REMEDIAL ACTIONS. THE MATERIAL CREATED A SHEEN AT THE TRENCH WITHIN THE BERTH. THE MATERIAL WAS REMOVED BY THE CONTRACTOR THAT RESPONDED. A STORM DRAIN AT THE LOCATION WAS ALSO AFFECTED DURING THIS INCIDENT. THE BROKEN HOSE WILL BE REMOVED ON 10/19/2026 AT AN UNSPECIFIED TIME. /// ORIGINAL REPORT BELOW /// THE CALLER REPORTS A BROKEN HYDRAULIC HOSE ON THE CARGO CRANE CAUSED 3 GALLONS TO SPRAY ONTO THE DECK AND DOCK OF THE TERMINAL. NO WATERWAY IMPACT. INCIDENT OCCURRED @ 1150 ET HOURS.
